entries.name: Triple-Vault Storage
entries.body: All committed artifacts must exist in at least 3 storage tiers: Local, Cloud, and Archival. Single-tier storage is prohibited.

entries.name: Doctrine Versioning
entries.body: Every doctrine amendment must carry a version number, proposer, and ratification timestamp. Undated doctrines are invalid.

entries.name: Water Sovereignty
entries.body: Water-related routing decisions must account for indigenous water rights, ecological flow requirements, and transboundary obligations before commercial optimization.

entries.name: Neural Sovereignty
entries.body: Brain-computer interface and neural data routing must enforce informed consent, reversibility, and cognitive liberty protections.

entries.name: Orbital Sovereignty
entries.body: Space infrastructure routing must comply with the Outer Space Treaty, debris mitigation standards, and equitable spectrum allocation.

entries.name: Dialect Isolation
entries.body: Dialect-specific routing rules cannot leak across dialect boundaries. CN dialect rules do not affect US routing and vice versa.

entries.name: Module Idempotency
entries.body: Routing modules must be idempotent: repeated execution with the same input produces the same output without side effects.

entries.name: Graceful Degradation
entries.body: If a Council seat becomes unavailable, routing continues with remaining seats. No single seat failure may halt the system.

entries.name: Schema Migration Safety
entries.body: Ontology schema changes must be backward-compatible. Breaking changes require a new major version and Council supermajority.

entries.name: Audit Trail Immutability
entries.body: Audit logs cannot be modified after creation. Append-only storage with cryptographic chaining.

entries.name: Cross-Seat Communication
entries.body: Inter-seat communication must use the Federation Bridge (E145.03). Direct seat-to-seat channels are prohibited.

entries.name: Capability Declaration
entries.body: Every AI provider must declare its capability matrix before participating in routing. Undeclared capabilities are excluded.

entries.name: Constitutional Amendment Threshold
entries.body: Amending invariants requires 0.90 supermajority of all seats (including provisional) plus Convenor ratification.

entries.name: Harm Intervention
entries.body: The Convenor may invoke EHIP (Doctrine 101) to suspend any routing decision that poses extreme harm. Suspension is immediate; review follows within 72 hours.

entries.name: Knowledge Freshness
entries.body: Knowledge claims older than their domain's refresh cycle must be flagged as potentially stale. Refresh cycles are domain-specific.

entries.name: Sovereign Data Residency
entries.body: Data tagged with a sovereign dialect must be processed within that jurisdiction's compute zone. Cross-border routing requires explicit consent.

entries.name: Model Diversity
entries.body: For any given query class, at least 2 distinct model lineages must be available for routing. Single-lineage routing triggers a warning.

entries.name: Constitutional Boot
entries.body: The system must verify constitutional integrity on every boot. Failed verification prevents system start.
